facts.subject: src/melee/ft/ftanim.c
facts.existing_value: Skeletal playback has inactive, direct, blending, and blend-complete behavior. An animation ID of -1 suppresses pose updates. A zero blend duration evaluates the visible hierarchy directly; a nonzero duration advances auxiliary-skeleton progress by its frame rate, clamps at the requested duration, interpolates while time remains, and copies the completed auxiliary pose when the transition ends. Temporary part animations use -1 slot sentinels, attach animation joints to selected bones, blend affected bones over a configured duration, and clear their bone flags when removed. Costume texture animations are initialized at rate zero and subsequently advance only when explicit frame requests are applied through the retained texture list.
